name: paseo
title: Paseo
description: Jump to Paseo workspaces and ask quick questions through a Paseo agent
author: chun

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Chat Model
preferences.description: Provider and model for quick chats

preferences.name: customModel
preferences.title: Custom Model
preferences.description: provider/model used when Chat Model is Custom, e.g. opencode/openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5. List models with `paseo provider models <provider>`.

preferences.name: thinking
preferences.title: Thinking
preferences.description: Thinking effort; options the model does not support are rejected by Paseo

preferences.name: readOnly
preferences.title: Read Only
preferences.label: Run chats in plan mode so they cannot edit files
preferences.description: Applies to providers with a plan mode (Claude, OpenCode)

preferences.name: chatDirectory
preferences.title: Chat Directory
preferences.description: Working directory for quick chat workspaces; created if missing

preferences.name: chatLabel
preferences.title: Chat Workspace Label
preferences.description: Label added to quick chat workspaces. Match the auto-archive plugin's quick chat label so they are archived sooner.

preferences.name: showQuickChats
preferences.title: Quick Chats
preferences.label: Show quick chat and glance workspaces in the workspace switcher
preferences.description: Quick chats are always listed in Ask Paseo, glance chats in glance's Ask About Screen

commands.name: workspaces
commands.title: Paseo Workspaces
commands.subtitle: Paseo
commands.description: Search Paseo workspaces and agents and open them in Paseo

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask Paseo
commands.subtitle: Paseo
commands.description: Ask a quick question through a Paseo agent
